catalogs.completeness_basis: The 2026-27 catalog states "Lewis & Clark offers 29 majors"; its Majors and Minors table marks 29 field majors (plus the student-designed major) in the Major column, and the catalog states "Undergraduate work at Lewis & Clark leads to the bachelor of arts degree". Every marked major has a verified record.

lines: Students with sophomore class standing of 45 or more completed credits must have a declared major. Those who have not officially declared a major with the Office of the Registrar will not be allowed to register for courses in any subsequent semester. First-semester students with more than 25 awarded advanced placement credits or transfer credits may be eligible for a one-semester extension, but must request the extension from the Office of the Registrar.
